from dataclasses import dataclass
import cattrs

@dataclass
class Item:
    count: int
    label: str = 'default'

r = cattrs.partial_structure({'count': '2'}, Item)
assert r.value == Item(2)
assert r.structured_fields == frozenset({'count'})
assert r.failed_fields == frozenset({'label'})
r = r.refine({'label': 'ok'})
assert r.is_complete and r.value == Item(2, 'ok')
print('partial structure reproduction passed')
